# Vulkan headers

Unmodified Khronos Vulkan API headers (header version 1.4.309, plus `vk_video/` included by `vulkan_core.h`), used to call
the system Vulkan loader (`vulkan-1.dll`) through function pointers. No
Vulkan library is linked at build time.

License: Apache-2.0 (see the SPDX line in each file). Source:
https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers
